items.title: A 'sun' that heals
items.description: Although nuclear fusion is still under development, the technologies created through China's fusion research are already being used in precision cancer treatment, aircraft engine inspection, chip manufacturing, and many other fields. In Anhui province, scientists vividly describe this innovation model as "laying eggs along the way"— turning breakthroughs made on the journey toward fusion into real-world applications. Sometimes, what truly lights up the world is not the destination, but every step taken along the way.
